company.shortDescription: Aleph Group is a digital advertising, fintech, and technology solutions company.
company.description: Aleph Group is a digital advertising, fintech, and technology solutions company that helps major digital platforms expand into emerging and high-growth markets around the world. The company operates as a bridge between global technology platforms and local advertisers, providing market expertise, media sales, payment infrastructure, and digital advertising solutions across more than 130 markets on five continents.
